title: Family beach week in 7 days
summary: Nha Trang, or Da Nang and Hoi An. Do not treat both bases as one week.

days.title: Day 1 — Arrive
days.body: Arrive in Nha Trang, or in Da Nang.

days.title: Day 2 — Hon Tre or My Khe
days.body: Hon Tre is a day on the island, or My Khe is half a day and free to swim. Do not do both.

days.title: Day 4 — Hon Mun or Hoi An
days.body: Hon Mun is a boat day, or walk Hoi An if you based in Da Nang.

days.title: Day 5 — A rest day
days.body: Keep the day on the sand.

days.title: Day 6 — Hoi An if you came north
days.body: An Bang is half a day if that is the base.

days.title: Day 7 — Leave
days.body: Fly out of Cam Ranh or Da Nang.
